page_title: PSG 2-0 AUX | PSG v Auxerre 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+5' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

90+3' Lucas Chevalier makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
90+2' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lucas Chevalier comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets booked.
88' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) misses a great chance after striking the ball towards the left side of the goal and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elisha Owusu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
87' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle as Bradley Barcola (PSG) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Auxerre in a dangerous position.
83' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
80' Today's match ends for Kang-In Lee who will be replaced by Mathis Jangeal (PSG).
79' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Kang-In Lee (PSG) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
77' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
75' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Kevin Danois will be replaced by Rudy Matondo (Auxerre).
74' It is time for a substitution. Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is on for Danny Namaso.

74' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
73' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
72' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Auxerre have a free kick.
71' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
67' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 7:1.
65' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Clement Akpa is replaced by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre).
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
62' Here comes a substitution. Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Senny Mayulu.
61' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. A free kick is awarded to PSG.

60' Senny Mayulu (PSG) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Auxerre, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
58' POST! Kevin Danois (Auxerre) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
54' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Senny Mayulu sends a long raking pass onto the head of Lucas Beraldo (PSG), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the roof of the net. 2:0.
54' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
50' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Senny Mayulu (PSG). It's a free kick to Auxerre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
47' Close! Sekou Mara (Auxerre) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
47' Bradley Barcola (PSG) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Donovan Leon.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sekou Mara (Auxerre) will replace Telli Siwe.
46' Luis Enrique makes a switch. Bradley Barcola (PSG) is coming on in place of Khvicha Kvaratskhelia at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45+3' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45+3' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Auxerre.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Kang-In Lee (PSG) brings an opponent down and Thomas Leonard interrupts the game. A free kick to Auxerre.
42' This shall not pass! Achraf Hakimi (PSG) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
41' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
39' Auxerre take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' Substitution. Vitinha did his best and is replaced by Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
32' 1 - 0 Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) gets on the end of a delightful cross and sends the ball inside the right post!
32' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

32' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
32' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Kang-In Lee (PSG) causes Donovan Leon little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
31' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement. Auxerre get a free kick.
29' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
26' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
25' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) is cautioned by the referee.
24' Referee Thomas Leonard sees the trip by Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PSG will take a free kick near the side line.

21' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just wide of the right post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
21' Telli Siwe (Auxerre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Telli Siwe (Auxerre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Telli Siwe (Auxerre) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. PSG earn a free kick.
16' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) commits a foul and Thomas Leonard immediately signals a free kick. Auxerre win a free kick.
15' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Flag goes up against Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece. Auxerre have been awarded a free kick.
7' Kang-In Lee (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
6' Half-chance! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Donovan Leon reacts well to snuff out the attack.

5' That didn't go as planned! Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Donovan Leon, who easily kept it out.

4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
3' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Auxerre will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Thomas Leonard.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
